# Catalog entries no feature-coverage scene uses yet, one "<kind> <name>" per
# line. `test_tools --feature-coverage` fails when a catalog entry is missing
# from both the scenes and this list, and when a listed entry becomes used.
# A feature PR covers its new entries in a scene; list one here only under a
# comment that gives the reason (a blank line ends a group), and remove lines
# as scenes start using them.

# Material simulation: fluids, destruction worlds, heat and combustion need a
# material field and solver scene.
component MaterialFluidWorld
component MaterialDestructionWorld
component MaterialBreakProfile
component MaterialThermal
component MaterialConstitutive
component MaterialTerrain
component GameCombustion
component GameFuel
component GameIgniter
component GameSubstance
component GameMaterialCavity
component GameFragmentGlow
component GameMaterialFrame
component GameFluidVolume

component GameSurfaceInfluence
component GameMeshAsset
component GameMeshParts
component GameMeshSurface2D
component GameShader
component GamePointLight
component GameEnvironment
component GameFog
component GameReflection
component GameVisualTransform
component GameVisualMotion
component GameRenderState
function Primitive Part
function Transform Visual Offset
function Trigger Visual Reaction

# 2D lighting, sky and camera.
component GameHRC2D
component GameStarfield2D
component GameCamera
component GameOrientation

# Visibility and fog of war.
component GameVision
function Visibility At

# Combat, encounters and pickups: gameplay modules a combat scene would cover.
component GameWeapon
